description: This file defines SSL configuration structures and constants for the Chromium project, including SSL protocol versions, SSLConfig struct with various SSL settings, and related enums and includes.

classes.name: SSLConfig
classes.description: A collection of SSL-related configuration settings, including protocol versions, certificate handling, ALPN protocols, and security options.

classes.name: SSLConfig::CertAndStatus
classes.description: A structure representing an SSL certificate and its associated status.

methods.name: SSLConfig()
methods.description: Default constructor for SSLConfig, initializes default SSL settings.

methods.name: bool IsAllowedBadCert(X509Certificate* cert, CertStatus* cert_status) const
methods.description: Checks if a given certificate is in the list of allowed bad certificates.

methods.name: int GetCertVerifyFlags() const
methods.description: Returns verification flags for certificate validation based on the SSLConfig settings.
